body:
This records fresh Windows PowerPoint tests of current native picture/furniture edits and notes packaging. Current text, image bytes and valid provenance survive the tested save/reopen flows; damaged provenance falls back to current ordinary content. Production notes ordering opens successfully, while both controlled reordered inputs are refused at `Presentations.Open` with `0x80070570`, so production behavior remains unchanged.

The bundle preserves original and edited PPTX files, full-slide rasters, exact worker snapshots and stage logs, semantic/native audits, failed comparisons, synthetic negative controls and cleanup observations. It records the observed clipping, duplicate overlap and Change Picture geometry change without claiming general layout fidelity. Both notes refusal reports retain unconfirmed cleanup; separate empty-workspace UI observations do not turn them into successful workers. D/E and broad compatibility acceptance remain outside this checkpoint.

Validation: all 516 payload hashes match staged Git blob bytes; an independent review checked the initial 514-file payload, and the supervisor added the portable verifier and hash-bound 21-image visual review. All 56 PPTX archives pass ZIP CRC/XML checks with no embedded font programs. `python docs/evidence/windows-native-edits-20260921/verify.py` passes. Raw stderr whitespace and CRLF are intentionally retained byte-for-byte. No proprietary fonts, PDFs, owner presentations or workspace screenshots are included.

Harness: https://github.com/OpenPresentation/opf-pptx/pull/47 (merged, Linux/Windows CI passed).
Evidence manifest SHA-256: `53a87939b557e4d2a81fc75e8a39255e535eab27056cfcf2f453d170d2c50de8`.

> [!NOTE]
> **Low Risk**
> Documentation and evidence-only additions with offline verification scripts; no production code paths change.
> 
> **Overview**
> Adds a **furniture baseline native** evidence slice under `docs/evidence/windows-native-edits-20260921/`, including hash-bound PowerShell harness snapshots (`native-furniture-control.ps1`, `native-process.ps1`), an **empty** `action-plan.json`, and terminal `progress.json` for a successful zero-action save/reopen run.
> 
> Introduces two **offline Python auditors** (`audit-furniture-native.py` and `audit-furniture-native-v1.py`) that validate worker cleanup, snapshot hashes, ordered `stages.jsonl`, native state persistence across save/reopen, planned-edit semantics, and saved PPTX ZIP/XML integrity without COM. The newer auditor adds per-phase slide/raster inventory checks and stricter action-plan reporting; **v1** writes a fixed `independent-native-audit.json` with a slightly different external-plan hash rule. Checked-in **`independent-native-audit.json`** and **`independent-native-audit-v2.json`** record both auditors passing against the same `report.json`.
> 
> A **`.gitattributes`** entry (`** -text`) marks the evidence tree for binary-safe checkout so CRLF and raw logs stay byte-stable.
>
